_doc: Skirmish AI personalities (P3-13b, docs/design/ai-opponent.md): overlays on a faction preset. first_attack_shift_s and wave_size_delta move the first attack and the wave size; max_gatherers_delta changes the truck count; defend_radius_delta_m widens the defended area; research 'none' skips research and 'all' researches every global upgrade of the faction; superweapon false never builds one; mix_boost multiplies the unit-mix weight of units by armor class; extra_defenses appends that many of each of the faction's defensive buildings to the build order. 'random' picks one of these per match from the AI's own seed.

rusher.name: Rusher
rusher.description: Attacks early and often with infantry and light vehicles; skips research and superweapons.

turtle.name: Turtle
turtle.description: Fortifies its base with extra defenses and attacks late, in big waves.

tech.name: Tech
tech.description: Researches every upgrade, favors aircraft and attacks a little later.
